name: Content Moderation Agent
summary: The company’s first production AI product: a content-moderation agent on a locally fine-tuned Qwen 2.5 model inside a NestJS platform.
detail: Synthetic data generation, reinforcement learning from eval results, and blind evaluations graders could not reliably call. 100% accuracy on the moderation filter, under 1% hallucination — serving 44 million students and teachers daily.
